summary: Residential kerb where cars park, but flats and houses overlook it and it is steep.

drivers.seclusion: North side has apartment blocks; nearest mapped homes 12 m at 26 m and 12 m at 70 m; houses about 20 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with kerbside parking; several cars parked along this kerb in the QLD image.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street near a junction, light traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb, so a van would not stand out; no signs.

flags: Homes within 25 m on both sides
sun_shade: Trees on the north side shade the section from the north and morning; open to the west.

best_section.where: Payne Street north kerb, beside the tree-lined flats' side car park
